images.name: Q5
images.prompt: Vertical epic cinematic film still, photorealistic, anamorphic lens, dramatic volumetric light, warm amber and gold color grade, fine film grain, shallow depth of field. Upper 40 percent of the frame is dark empty sky or shadow for text; subject in the lower half. Animals with natural correct anatomy. No text, letters, logos or watermarks. Dramatic low angle looking up at two white domestic geese with orange beaks flying side by side, each holding one end of a wooden stick, a tortoise hanging by its mouth from the middle of the stick, against a dark stormy sky, tense cliffhanger mood.
